decision: Reuse the existing Заказать action. Reorder when all previous requests containing the product have finished and stock at the selected point is insufficient. No additional reorder button or automatic reserve.
oldBehavior: Deal cards used native Material Request status only and ignored actual document completion used by the supply journal. Completed deliveries could still hide the order action and display a received badge despite current stock shortage.

newBehavior.progress: Deal cards and supply journal share loadSupplyOrderProgress and calculateRequestProgress. posted/received transfers and posted purchase receipts at the request destination fulfill quantities; partial shortages, corrections, stale request keys, drafts and receipts at another point cannot falsely finish a request.
newBehavior.repeat: A completed historical request no longer blocks the product. The existing action is shown after selection if the chosen point is short; form defaults to shortage, leaving destination selection explicit.
newBehavior.firstOrder: Existing first-order behavior and manually selected destination are preserved.
newBehavior.server: Before creation, reload request progress and current destination stock/remaining plan. Any matching unfinished request blocks submission; repeated quantity cannot exceed current shortage. Per-deal creation lock guards simultaneous clicks in the current single backend process.
newBehavior.history: Create a separate Material Request with its own identity; never reopen, cancel, edit or erase the fulfilled request, transfer or purchase history.
newBehavior.failure: An unreadable registry does not become an empty list. Deal shows an actionable supply error and hides ordering; server refuses to write if it cannot verify progress.
newBehavior.duplicateProductRows: Stock and delivered/cancelled product quantities are distributed once across duplicate rows, preventing false completion after partial delivery.
newBehavior.receivedDisplay: Historic transfer receipt no longer overrides current shortage with a ready badge; the existing stock-refresh action remains.

unchangedSources: ERP Material Request, Purchase Order and Purchase Receipt
B24 ctv_transfers entity with complete cursor reads
ERP deal plan, Delivery Note and Bin stock
architecture.changedProjection: Effective completion is derived from linked delivery documents; native Material Request status is not rewritten.

verification.browser: Real DealProductsWorkspace with mocked data and production styles: completed+shortage enables existing Заказать; pending request, enough stock and read error hide it; form needs 3, available 1, requested 2.
verification.serverRegression: Creates one new request after completion, keeps original byte-equivalent, blocks simultaneous submit and later duplicate, refuses unknown progress.
verification.featureAudit: Prior five restored regressions remain in normal suites; intentional INV-06 retirement retained; test counts increased from 379/176 to 383/179.

release: Prepared implementation; production deployment requires approval of the resulting release.
